purpose: New-series census stage 1 (Idea Desk C, owner MAIN): lists of OPEN and UNOPENED non-combo markets created since 2026-10-14, for series tickers, titles and created, open and close times only. No price field is read and no settled market is requested.
heldout: Only open and unopened markets are listed (created on or after 2026-10-14); no settled market and no result is in any answer. The reader keeps ticker, event_ticker, series prefix, title, created_time, open_time and close_time, and drops every price, size and volume field unread. No card's held-out reads open markets' outcomes, since none exist yet.

stop_rules.note: a 429 is waited out with a doubling pause and the same request is asked again; three in a row end the run; no other address, no proxy, no retry around a refusal

notes: Two lists, newest created first: status=open and status=unopened, min_created_ts 2026-10-14T00:00:00Z (1791936000), mve_filter=exclude, 1,000 a page, up to 50 pages each, the runner's page limit (about 100,000 markets at most; the count is unknown, so the run stops cleanly at the page cap and reports truncation). Cap 110 (10 spare for 429 retries).
